fusions.name: Feint and Nip
fusions.desc: Consumes one of your afflictions on the target to dart in for 8 damage from an unexpected side, with a 40% chance to leave it [Blunted] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Took What It Wanted
fusions.desc: A thieving bite that deals 28 damage, always lands as a critical hit, and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds. It leaves the target [Damped] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Not Mine
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever cast it. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Trick Played
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, your next strike has 15% more critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds. Your dodge chance rises by 4%.
